$comment: Per-system settings the kiln engine and gates read. Created by kiln create; Phase 0 fills the names, Phase 2 flips tokens.allowSeed to false. Empty lists make gates FAIL on purpose (nothing proven), never pass.
name: {{name}}

autonomy.$comment: agent = after the intake and anchor pick, the agent makes every derivation pick itself and records it in system/REVIEW.md for the milestone review (user setting, 2026-10-27). user = ask for each pick.

milestone.$comment: M1 = infrastructure + wave 1 at full depth; see the kiln skill references/milestones.md

tokens.$comment: baseTheme is the theme $value describes. allowSeed lets the starter's SEED tokens build until Phase 2 replaces them; the M1 gate fails while it is true.

tone.$exclude: the decision log and exceptions register are records written in the team's working language through lock-decision, rendered as kept; every other page is book prose and is linted

rationale.$comment: components built before a derivation round; the list may only shrink

advisory.G-TODO1: the starter's TODO(phase) placeholders and SEED reasons; Phases 1–2 and the wave replace them, and the milestone check refuses M1 while this is red
advisory.G-N1: system/controls.tsx is native until wave 1 builds this system's own Select and Slider; the docs need them, so they are in wave 1
advisory.G-BT1: the foundation topics are this system's own prose (system/foundation-extras.tsx), written in Phase 2 once the tokens carry real decisions
advisory.G-SV1: the state matrix (apps/docs/src/system/states.tsx) is empty until wave 1 builds a component with states; each one adds its row as it passes QA
advisory.G-AN1: the anchor is picked and recorded after Phase 1; until then there is nothing to compare the card with

docs.$advisory: Gates listed in advisory are run and shown as ! but do not fail verify. Each needs a reason. tooling/kiln/milestone.mjs fails while any advisory gate is red, so this list must be empty when a milestone closes.
docs.$scenes: backdrop ids from apps/docs/src/system/backdrops.tsx, default first. G-ST1 fails when the book has a backdrop control and this list is empty. A system on photographs lists every scene and sets photoScene to the brightest one (G-BR1 checks text over it).

treeShake.$comment: G-TS1 (treeshake-probe.mjs): importing probe alone must cost only that component. packages/react/vite.config.ts keeps preserveModules for this; set probe to a wave-1 component with its own CSS once one exists.

glassRecipe.$comment: G-GR1: every backdrop-filter in component CSS is none or written through tokens, and what renders carries every function here (docs/style-recipes/glass.md). A system with no glass passes.

anchor.$comment: G-AN1: at the anchor lock run node tooling/kiln/anchor-likeness.mjs --record apps/lab/anchor/<picked>.html, then set route to the book page whose example carries data-anchor on the current card.
